watch.summary: A streamer turns down a high-ranked Rocket League challenger, explaining he only wants to 1v1 terrible players who have thousands of hours in the game.

beats.what: A challenger in voice chat asks to 1v1, boasting about being Champ 3 with 561 hours.
The streamer palms his head, disappointed by the challenger's high rank.
The streamer states he only wants to 1v1 someone who is Bronze 4 with 2,000 hours.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I wanna hear I'm bronze 4 in freaking 3s and 1s with 2000 hours
watch.why: The streamer subverts the usual gamer ego by explicitly looking for terrible opponents to fight rather than skilled ones. His earnest, deadpan insistence on wanting a 'Bronze 4 with 2,000 hours' creates a great subversion of expectations.
